topic: What happens if you only sleep four hours a night?
title: What too little sleep does
hook: What happens if you only sleep four hours?

beats.label: 1 NIGHT
beats.line: After one night of just four hours, your focus and reaction time drop.

beats.label: 3 NIGHTS
beats.line: By the third short night, hunger hormones rise, and cravings grow stronger.

beats.label: 1 WEEK
beats.line: After a week like this, your immune system weakens too.

beats.label: 2 WEEKS
beats.line: After two full weeks, mood drops, and small things feel much harder.

end.line: How many hours did you sleep last night?

description: How losing sleep night after night affects focus, hunger, immunity and mood.

facts.claim: Even one short night of sleep can slow reaction time and reduce focus.
Short sleep can raise the hunger hormone ghrelin and lower leptin, increasing appetite.
Ongoing lack of sleep can weaken the immune system's response.
Chronic short sleep is linked to worse mood and irritability.
